description: This Java class implements the <call-class-method> element for a mini-language processing framework, enabling dynamic invocation of class methods with specified parameters and handling return values.

classes.name: CallClassMethod
classes.description: Represents a mini-language element that calls a static method on a specified class with parameters, and optionally stores the result.

classes.name: CallClassMethodFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of CallClassMethod from XML elements.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the class method call within the given method context.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the CallClassMethod instance.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate CallClassMethod from an XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for the factory, 'call-class-method'.
